entities.summary: Adis Bećiragić is a Bosnian-Turkish professional basketball coach and former player who is currently the head coach for Trepça of the Kosovo ProCredit Superliga. He was a backbone player of the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team team during the 1990s. Bećiragić ended his playing career in 2000, and has worked as a basketball coach since 2007.
